title: Collard Greens with Dutch-Style Nutty Croutons
description: A hearty vegetarian side dish featuring crispy croutons, crunchy collard greens, and a hint of nutty flavor.
instructions: Toss bread with a pinch of salt until evenly coated.
Drizzle nutty oil over bread and toss to coat.
Spread bread on a baking sheet and bake for 10-12 minutes, or until crispy.
In a large skillet, heat a pinch of salt and a pinch of pepper over medium heat.
Add chopped collards and cook until wilted, about 5-7 minutes.
Stir in croutons and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
